3.234 System Constraint
Definition
Boundary conditions that restrict the Design-Freedom of the (cars E/E-) System.
Initiator
WP System Constraint Template
Further
Explanations
The design of ECU Networks and the distribution of functionalities to ECUs are
limited by several constrains. These constraints result mostly by the
communication matrix and safety requirements
Comment
--
Example
An existing communication matrix that restricts the distribution of signals to frames
is a system constraint. Another system constraint is a safety requirement that
does not allow to map a specified Software component to specific ECU.
Reference
--
